limits: Labels are whole-clip good/bad, not time-resolved expert fault annotations.
Pose landmarks are model outputs, not independent keypoint ground truth.
Overlapping windows are correlated; do not treat them as independent people.
Scores are uncalibrated and must not be described as form probabilities.
Thresholds are chosen on validation subjects only; no phone or clinical qualification.
Runtime modality/input resolution and false detections need independent validation.
Held-out results do not qualify these models for production corrections. Runtime needsReview remains false while release_approved is false.
Push-ups have zero reliable validation windows at unchanged confidence/coverage gates; no quality model is fitted for them.
Input videos retain source geometry. No frame-level expert annotations, force data, clinical validation or physical-phone validation were obtained.
